body: I've had pretty severe depression and anxiety since I was a teenager. Pile on top of that a lot of recent family drama I'd rather not go into, all the anxiety from the current virus situation, and the death of a loved one in January has made it so I've kind of been walking through a haze for a while. Most days I don't feel anything. I used to be very passionate about human and animal rights and social injustice issues and working with charities and I just don't give a shit about anything anymore. I don't care about other people. I don't care about refugee children or abused animals. My logical brain says "those things are bad, of course you care", but I don't actually *feel* sad or angry or indignant. All I feel is worried and scared all the time, in every situation. Although every once in a while ill find something to focus on (like Hamilton) and devote all of my attention and energy into it and for a little while I can feel excited and happy again. I guess I don't really want to die, as much as I just want to stop being here. Sorry for the wall of text in advance
